logp.method_description: The complex's lipophilicity (log Po/w) was determined by the shake flask method using an octanol-water system. Equal concentrations of the metal complex (1 mM) in 2.5 ml of octanol and 2.5 ml of water were taken in a shake flask and stirred at room temperature for 24 h. The solution was transferred to a separating funnel and allowed to stand overnight to separate both phases. After separating both phases, measured their absorbance at its wavelength maximum to calculate its concentration inrespective phases. The log Po/w value will be calculated according to equation 1.

The octanol–water distribution coefficients were determined at pH 7.4 using the shake-flask method. (57,58) Briefly, solutions of the tested compounds (16 μM) in phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) were mixed with n-octanol in flasks at three different PBS:n-octanol ratios (1:1, 0.5:1, 2:1). The mixtures were manually shaken to allow equilibration between the organic and aqueous phases. Subsequently, phase separation was achieved by centrifugation at 4000 rpm for 10 min. The concentrations of ruthenium compounds in both phases were then determined spectrophotometrically. The log P7.4 values were calculated as the mean value of the log[Ru-pCy1–5]oct/[Ru-pCy1–5]PBS/4 values obtained from the three different PBS:n-octanol ratio samples for each complex.
